roadmap.title: How you will use it:
roadmap.subtitle: Learn to enjoy life again with us
roadmap.step1Desc: In the first stage, users analyze their emotional state through short tests and daily notes. The system identifies stress, anxiety, and emotional states to provide personalized recommendations.
roadmap.step2Desc: Users can securely and comfortably connect with professional psychologists. Online consultation and personal guidance foster healthier perspectives on life challenges.
roadmap.step3Desc: Through guided meditation, breathing exercises, and personal development tasks, users begin to feel more balanced and confident. The goal is long-term inner peace and clarity.

features.title: Find inner balance, understand yourself better.
features.subtitle: A safe haven for psychological support and personal development
features.card1Desc: This platform is designed to help you understand your thoughts, manage emotions, and navigate daily stress healthily. You are not alone. Choose a space you love and begin therapy.
features.card2Desc: Strengthen your psychological wellbeing with small steps. Feel more balanced with breathing exercises, brief meditations, and daily reflection.
features.card3Desc: Write your thoughts and discover yourself deeper. Track your emotional state and witness your personal growth by journaling daily feelings.
features.card4Desc: Share thoughts, receive encouragement, and feel that you are never alone in a supportive space with people who share similar journeys.

pillars.title: 6 Core Pillars of Psychological Health
pillars.p1Content: Develops the ability to recognize, name, and express feelings constructively. This forms the foundation of inner balance.
pillars.p2Content: Helps discover physical sensations and tension patterns in the body and gently release them.
pillars.p3Content: Breaks negative thought loops and builds a more positive, rational, and adaptive mindset.
pillars.p4Content: Establishing healthy interpersonal boundaries and nurturing empathetic communication.
pillars.p5Content: Fosters intrinsic motivation and helps you uncover what truly inspires you forward.
pillars.p6Content: Understanding your own authentic needs and cultivating the courage to say "no" when needed.

testimonials.title: Real Life Stories
testimonials.t1Text: Long-term stress and anxiety were making my daily routine overwhelming. Even minor events used to drain me quickly and I struggled to concentrate. After receiving psychological guidance, I learned how to manage my thoughts, and gradually my inner calm was restored. Now I feel much more stable and secure.
testimonials.t2Text: Prolonged tension and emotional neglect within family life had deeply affected me. I often felt anxious, exhausted, and distant from people. With psychologist support, I began to understand this condition. During sessions, I learned to express my feelings, set healthy boundaries, and apply stress management techniques. Today I feel balanced.

miniGames.headerTitle: Choose your preferred technique and begin!
miniGames.headerSubtitle: Make sure to learn the technique first

naturalSteps: Sit or lie down in a comfortable position.
Inhale slowly and deeply through your nose.
pranayamaSteps: Close your right nostril, inhale through the left.
Briefly hold your breath with both nostrils closed.
Close the left and exhale through the right.
Repeat the sequence on the opposite side.
ujjayiSteps: Slightly constrict your throat, inhale through your nose.
Exhale slowly while maintaining slight constriction.
Focus on the soothing "ocean wave" sound.
Keep the rhythm calm and steady.
